summary.intent: Run a post-phase code review (reuse, quality, efficiency) on all Phase 25 changes and fix any issues found.
summary.outcome: Two concrete issues were fixed and committed: (1) duplicate frontend build step removed from CI workflow, saving ~6 minutes per release; (2) `has_tee_enrollment` borrow pattern simplified in both Unix and Windows FUSE operations files.

repo: `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` and `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` are the same function — `ecies::wrap_key` is re-exported at lib.rs:18, so call-site divergence is not a bug.
The CI workflow `build-desktop.yml` had a double frontend build: `pnpm vite build` ran explicitly AND was triggered again via `beforeBuildCommand` in the Tauri config.
TEE wrapping logic is duplicated across multiple `operations.rs` files (at least Unix and Windows platform variants), suggesting a shared helper extraction opportunity remains.

code.finding: `has_tee_enrollment` was computed after construction via a borrow; simplified to derive the boolean directly from inputs before construction.
Same `has_tee_enrollment` borrow pattern as Unix operations.rs — fixed in parallel.
Redundant explicit `pnpm vite build` step removed; Tauri's `beforeBuildCommand` already handles the frontend build.

workflow: Three-agent parallel review (reuse, quality, efficiency) with aggregation before fixing is an effective pattern for post-phase cleanup.
Verifying crypto re-export paths before classifying a divergence as a bug avoids unnecessary refactoring.
Compilation verification after simplification edits (before committing) caught any regressions early.

friction: Several findings from the review agents (9-param sprawl, notification pattern, `is_new_file` duplication) were assessed as low-priority or acceptable and skipped without fixes — requires judgment calls on what to act on.
open_items: TEE wrapping logic is duplicated ~4 times across operations.rs files — extracting a shared helper was identified but deferred.
Parameter sprawl (9 params) on at least one function noted but not addressed.
